normalization.double_normalization_gate: data loader applies once; exported model and Runner apply zero additional normalization
normalization.operation: (reflectance - training_mean) / training_std in FP32 exactly once
normalization.statistics_source: 256 deterministic coverage-stratified unique ROIs from the frozen training set only

reflectance.clipping: none; nodata excluded before statistics and training

spatial_sampling.calibration: deterministic stratified 224x224 crops from calibration set only
spatial_sampling.deployment_validation: deterministic hashed 224x224 crops from deployment-validation set only
spatial_sampling.formal_test: same frozen sliding-window rule after pretest freeze only
spatial_sampling.training: seeded random 224x224 crops fully inside the valid 509x509 window
spatial_sampling.validation_and_task_evaluation: deterministic 224x224 sliding windows; starts [0,112,224,285] on each axis; average overlapping logits; evaluate only valid 509x509 pixels

stored_raster.native_band_resolution_note: B8A/B11/B12 are natively 20 m but are already aligned in the official L2A TACO 10 m raster. No downstream band resampling is applied.
stored_raster.upstream_resampling_algorithm: not published in the audited metadata; treat stored pixels as the source product
